commands.name: Create Android release keystore
commands.description: Generate a signing key and keystore; protect and back up the private key securely.

commands.name: List keystore certificates
commands.description: Inspect entries and certificate details in a keystore.

commands.name: Export certificate from keystore
commands.description: Export the public certificate associated with a keystore alias.

commands.name: Align APK before signing
commands.description: Align an APK before signing it with apksigner.

commands.name: Sign an APK
commands.description: Sign an aligned APK using a keystore; the tool prompts for credentials when needed.

commands.name: Verify APK signature
commands.description: Verify an APK signature and print its certificate information.

commands.name: Sign an App Bundle
commands.description: Sign an Android App Bundle with a keystore; credentials are prompted interactively.

commands.name: Verify signed archive
commands.description: Verify signatures in a JAR or signed archive.
